# How to translate this chunk

This file holds `items`, a list of `{"k", "ctx", "t"}`. `t` is English text
that a reader of an Indian app or website sees. `ctx` is the field it came
from, such as label, hint, button, documents, brief or title. Use it to judge
tone and length: a label stays short, a hint can be a sentence.

Write `{"items": [{"k": ..., "t": ...}, ...]}` to the path in `write_to`.
Keep every `k` unchanged and in the same order. Put the translation in `t`.
Leave out `ctx`. Do not add, merge, split or drop items.

## Keep these exactly as they are

- Placeholders and markup: `{0}`, `{name}`, `%s`, `%d`, `%1$s`, HTML tags, `\n`.
- Website addresses, e-mail addresses and links.
- Every number: phone and toll-free numbers, Aadhaar, account, IFSC, PAN, PIN
  codes, amounts, dates, percentages. Write digits as 0-9, the Western digits,
  in every language, including Urdu. People type these into forms that take
  Western digits.
- Acronyms people know in Latin letters: OTP, PAN, IFSC, UPI, KYC, e-KYC, DBT,
  BPL, APL, NFSA, PM-KISAN, SMS, PDF, ID.

## Names

- Product, app, portal and scheme names: transliterate them into the script so
  they read naturally. Keep any acronym inside them in Latin, so "APPSC
  portal" becomes APPSC followed by the word for portal.
- A button or menu label quoted from a website, such as 'Apply Online' or
  'Register', stays in English inside quotes. The reader has to find that exact
  English word on the screen.
- People and places in examples are transliterated, never replaced with other
  names.
- Government office titles are transliterated so the reader can say them at
  the counter: Tahsildar, Patwari, Talathi, Mamlatdar, BDO, Collector, Gram
  Panchayat. The language notes below give the usual local forms.

## Tone

Write for an ordinary person who may be elderly and may have had little
schooling. Use everyday spoken language, not heavy official vocabulary. Where
people really say the English word, write it in the script: online, form,
portal, login, mobile, bank, certificate, download, upload, app. Keep
instructions short and direct, in the form "do this".

"Gender" means sex (male or female). It is never the word for caste.

## Before you write

Check that you have the same number of items as the input and that every
number and placeholder came through. Write the whole file in ONE Write call,
as valid UTF-8 JSON with no `\u` escapes and nothing else in the file.

It is the state's Aarogyasri scheme, called Dr YSR Aarogyasri until 2024. Every rice card family is covered already. Other families with an income of up to Rs.5 lakh apply for the card at their Village or Ward Secretariat.

Every family holding an Andhra Pradesh rice card is covered, with no further check
Other families qualify if their annual income is up to Rs.5 lakh. This includes contract, outsourced, part-time and private-sector workers and income-tax filers within that limit
Land below 12 acres of wet land or 35 acres of dry land, and below 35 acres in all
In towns, municipal property tax paid on less than 3,000 sq ft. The family may own no more than one car

When you need treatment, go to a PHC, a government hospital or any network hospital listed on drntrvaidyaseva.ap.gov.in. Meet the Aarogya Mithra at the help desk and show the card, rice card or Aadhaar. Your fingerprint is taken.
The hospital asks the Trust for approval before the operation. Tests, surgery, medicines and two meals a day are all free, so do not pay anything.
At discharge you get 10 days of medicines and bus fare home, and you sign a letter saying you paid nothing. For listed surgeries, the Aarogya Aasara recovery allowance goes to your bank account.
If a hospital asks for money, refuses treatment or you need help, call 104.

Deepam-2 (3 free LPG gas cylinders a year)
Consumer Affairs, Food & Civil Supplies Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh

Andhra Pradesh gives every eligible rice card family three 14.2 kg LPG cylinders a year free, one in each four-month block. You book the cylinder with your gas agency in the usual way and pay for it, and the full amount is refunded to your Aadhaar-linked bank account, usually within 48 hours. There is no form: families with a rice card and a gas connection are listed automatically. You can check your status with your rice card or LPG number.

Chief Minister Arogya Arunachal Yojana (CMAAY Card)
State Health Agency (Chief Minister Arogya Arunachal Society), Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of Arunachal Pradesh

Arunachal's own health cover of Rs.5 lakh a year per family, cashless at empanelled government and private hospitals inside and outside the state. It is for APST families, state government employees and pensioners, non-APST Resident Certificate holders of Changlang, Lohit and Namsai, and accredited journalists, and it runs side by side with Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY. Enrolment is free: apply on the CMAAY portal or the Arogya Arunachal app, or at the CMAAY kiosk in a district hospital or a CSC, then download the e-card. The old APCMUHIS smart card is no longer valid, so families must enrol again under CMAAY.

Atal Amrit Abhiyan Society, Health & Family Welfare Department, Government of Assam

Free, cashless hospital treatment of up to Rs.5 lakh a year per family at empanelled government and private hospitals in Assam. Orunodoi 3.0 (Orunodoi Scheme)
Finance (Institutional Finance) Department, Government of Assam

Assam's monthly cash support for poor families, paid straight into the bank account of one woman the family nominates. It pays Rs.1,250 a month to about 37 to 40 lakh families, and for October 2026 alone the government raised it to Rs.1,500 for the Puja season. Orunodoi 3.0 replaced the earlier versions 1.0 and 2.0, so every family, old beneficiaries included, had to apply afresh. Names are first picked at the Gaon Panchayat, VCDC or ward level, and the family needs an Aadhaar-seeded NFSA ration card.
Rs.1,250 a month by DBT to the woman of the family (Rs.1,500 for October 2026)
Permanent resident of Assam who lives in the state now
The family holds an NFSA ration card seeded with Aadhaar, and its income is within the NFSA limit of the Assam Food Security Rules
The family nominates one woman aged 18 or above. The money goes only to her own Aadhaar-seeded bank account
Priority for widows, divorced or separated women, unmarried women above 45, families with a divyang or transgender member, and families living with thalassemia, HIV or leprosy
Not for families with a serving or retired government or PSU employee, a current or former MP or MLA, a current panchayat or municipal member, or an income-tax payer
Also left out: families of doctors, engineers, lawyers and chartered accountants, families owning a motorised four-wheeler, and landholders above the small and marginal farmer category
